name: Safenet Explorer
summary: Safenet Explorer, open source (Apache-2.0) in safe-research/safenet, explorer/. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it reads chain data from the public Gnosis RPC endpoint rpc.gnosischain.com without a light client, and the other networks use their own public RPC endpoints and Etherscan-style APIs when chosen.
